items.source: Intended for use as a delegate.

NOTE: If there is an explicit way to access the ServletContext, prefer such a way over using this class. The WebApplicationContextUtils class allows for easy access to the Spring root web application context based on the ServletContext.
items.translation: 注意：如果存在显式访问 ServletContext 的方式，请优先采用该方式，而不是使用此类。WebApplicationContextUtils类允许基于 ServletContext 轻松访问 Spring 根 Web 应用程序上下文。

items.source: A typical usage of this base class is a JAX-WS endpoint class: Such a Spring-based JAX-WS endpoint implementation will follow the standard JAX-WS contract for endpoint classes but will be 'thin' in that it delegates the actual work to one or more Spring-managed service beans - typically obtained using @Autowired. The lifecycle of such an endpoint instance will be managed by the JAX-WS runtime, hence the need for this base class to provide @Autowired processing based on the current Spring context.
items.translation: 此类基础类的典型用法是 JAX-WS 端点类： 基于 Spring 的此类 JAX-WS 端点实现将遵循端点类的标准 JAX-WS 契约，但其设计“轻量”，因为它会将实际工作委托给一个或多个由 Spring 管理的服务 Bean——通常通过 `@Autowired` 获取。 此类端点实例的生命周期将由 JAX-WS 运行时管理，因此需要此基础类提供基于当前 Spring 上下文的 `@Autowired` 处理机制。

items.source: Intended for use as a base class.
servletContext - the ServletContext to find the Spring web application context in
items.translation: servletContext - 在其中查找 Spring Web 应用程序上下文的 ServletContext

items.source: Process @Autowired injection for the given target object, based on the current web application context.
items.translation: 根据当前 Web 应用程序上下文，为给定的目标对象处理 `@Autowired` 注入。

items.source: Process @Autowired injection for the given target object, based on the current root web application context as stored in the ServletContext.
items.translation: 为给定目标对象处理 `@Autowired` 注入，基于存储在 `ServletContext` 中的当前根 Web 应用程序上下文。

items.source:
This constructor performs injection on this instance,
based on the current web application context.
items.translation: 此构造函数基于当前 Web 应用程序上下文，在此实例上执行注入。
